sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.1807 of 2023 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C., Kalikote arising out of Rambha P.S. Case No.674 of 2023 for commission of offences punishable under Section 420 of IPC.
3.

It is submitted by the leaned counsel for the Petitioner that taking into account nature of allegation which prima facie amounts to violation of contractual obligation, Petitioner has been implicated in the case at hand giving it a colour of criminality.
4. It is further submitted that the co-accused has since been released on bail.
Hence, the Petitioner may be protected by pre-arrest bail.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer referring to the criminal antecedent of the Petitioner of similar nature.

6. Taking into account the nature of allegations and the release of the co-accused, who is the husband of the Petitioner and that the Petitioner is a lady, this Court directs that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioner shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms as deemed just and proper.
